title: Compile Continuity Head deterministically from durable truth
problem: CONTINUITY_HEAD.json explicitly declares MANUAL_SEED_UNTIL_COMPILER_EXISTS and was last updated at 09:49 local. During this /wc activation, exact durable evidence had already advanced far beyond that projection: four local integrations and the 50-worker stress verifier had RETURNs, the multi-surface integration was stale/recovery-eligible, and a recovery attempt was later pinned. The head still projected older wave states and /wc v3.1. A separate proposal already targets bootstrap-version drift; this proposal targets the broader systemic cause: the continuity head is manually maintained rather than deterministically compiled from source truth, so any individual string fix can drift again.
mission: Build a candidate-only deterministic continuity-head compiler that consumes exact durable queues, claims, runs, returns, recovery evidence, generation state, portfolio state and explicit authority pointers, then emits a compact reproducible head plus source receipt. The compiler must fail closed on ambiguous/conflicting evidence, preserve Candidate/Verified/Human Accepted/Current/Served distinctions, and never self-promote production /w. Promotion/replacement of the current manual head remains a separate authority decision after canary verification.
acceptance: compiler runs from repository durable inputs without transcript or human task wording
identical durable inputs yield the same logical continuity head and provenance receipt
compiled head derives active/returned/stale/recovery/blocker state from exact lifecycle evidence rather than copying static queue labels
bootstrap/runtime version fields are sourced from exact evidence or explicitly freshness-bounded
contradictory or incomplete evidence is surfaced as UNPROVEN/BLOCKED/SOURCE_DEBT rather than guessed
fixture proving a stale manual-style snapshot is corrected by compilation passes
no Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority is synthesized

compounding_value.reason: Every fresh guide/worker reads Continuity Head early; compiling it removes repeated reconstruction tax and makes future waves inherit the live frontier instead of stale manual projections.

regression_prevention.reason: Fixes the mechanism that allowed queue, recovery and bootstrap fields to drift, rather than patching each stale field independently.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Moves frontier reconstruction away from the human and individual chats toward reproducible durable compilation.

verification_value.reason: A source receipt makes successor parity and state claims independently auditable instead of trusting a manually edited head.

candidate_read_scope: state authority pointers required by the compiler
falsification: A deterministic continuity-head compiler already exists and is demonstrably used to generate the current head with durable receipts.
The current manual head is intentionally non-current and no bootstrap/guide/worker consumes it as a current-state projection.
Existing compiler/runtime machinery already derives all head fields from exact durable truth and the observed stale state came only from a deployment defect covered by another active task.

risk.main: A naive compiler could collapse authority layers or turn noisy transient worker activity into misleading current state.
risk.mitigation: Compile only typed durable evidence, preserve truth classes, emit provenance for every derived frontier field, fail closed on conflict, and canary the generated head before any replacement/promotion.
